articles.title: Everything Coming to HBO Max in September
articles.summary: While the Paramount and Warner Bros. deal continues to sit in legal limbo, HBO Max is chugging along with another strong lineup of new additions in September.
body: There’s some particular highlights we’d recommend tuning into next month, but you can also jump ahead to everything coming to HBO Max in September by day.

DC Studios’ Lanterns will continue to air and stream new episodes in HBO’s primetime slot on Sunday nights. The series is a new take on the Green Lantern lore, starring Kyle Chandler as the veteran Hal Gordon and Aaron Pierre as the new recruit John Stewart. We’ve been pretty impressed with the series so far, calling the premiere “a critical return to form for the DCU.”

Before Kane Parsons (yes, Backrooms is also on this list), we had the Philippou brothers. These content creators marked their directorial debut with Talk to Me, a harrowing horror movie we gave a particularly strong 9/10 and called “engrossing, inventive, and, at times, unsettling.”
While Talk to Me was first released back in 2019, it hasn’t been streaming anywhere for quite some time, making the return to HBO Max particularly significant.

articles.title: Ridley Scott Says Alien: Romulus 'Was OK,' So He's Returning to the Franchise Because It 'Needs Some Help'
articles.summary: Director Ridley Scott said Alien: Romulus "was OK," so he's returning to the Alien franchise because it "needs some help." The director behind classic movies like Blade Runner and the original Alien, as well as the newly released The Dog Stars, made his feelings about the direction the sci-fi…
body: "I'm rewriting the next Alien film," Scott explained. "Actually, I suddenly went back and got involved. The one that just came out [2024's Alien: Romulus], it was OK. I think it needs some help. So, I've gone back in."

Alien: Romulus served as a soft reboot for the Alien universe by plopping new characters like Rain (Cailee Spaeny), Andy the android (David Jonsson), and Kay (Isabela Merced) into a story polluted by Xenomorphs, Facehuggers, and if you made it to the end of the film, something…else. It was generally favorably reviewed, with aggregator Rotten Tomatoes reporting an 80% critic score and an 85% audience score.
IGN gave it an 8/10 review. We said its "back-to-basics approach to blockbuster horror boils everything fans love about the tonally-fluid franchise into one brutal, nerve-wracking experience."
For Scott's tastes, however, it seems it simply wasn't enough. It's strange, considering that film's director, Fede Álvarez, said Scott told him it was "f**king great" after watching an early cut.
points: Director Ridley Scott said Alien: Romulus "was OK," so he's returning to the Alien franchise because it "needs some help.
"I'm rewriting the next Alien film," Scott explained.
"Actually, I suddenly went back and got involved.
The one that just came out [2024's Alien: Romulus], it was OK.

articles.title: Tom Cruise's Next Movie Is Not One You'd Expect
articles.summary: Tom Cruise and Paramount Pictures have announced a sequel to Cruise's first big hit of the 1990s: Days of Thunder. Rumored for some time, the sequel will hit theaters in 2028 and also star Anne Hathaway, who has had a big summer with The Odyssey and The End of Oak Street.
body: The original Days of Thunder followed Tom Cruise as Cole Trickle, a race car driver thrown into the wild world of NASCAR. Following the success of Top Gun: Maverick, reports emerged that Tom Cruise and Paramount were looking into reviving Days of Thunder.

Now, we know those reports were true, as Tom Cruise posted a short video about it on X. This video not only confirmed that Anne Hathaway will star in the movie with him and revealed a special race car livery that promoted a summer 2028 release window.

Plot details are still under wraps, and we don't know whether any of the original cast other than Cruise will return. Paramount did confirm that Cruise will portray Cole Trickle once again and that Hathaway's character is a "team owner and engineer" who is important to the sequel's narrative, though. It also narrowed the release window to June 2, 2028.
points: Tom Cruise and Paramount Pictures have announced a sequel to Cruise's first big hit of the 1990s: Days of Thunder.
Rumored for some time, the sequel will hit theaters in 2028 and also star Anne Hathaway, who has had a big summer with The Odyssey and The End of Oak Street.

articles.title: Fibbage Card Game Review
articles.summary: If you were attending parties in the mid 2010s, there is a pretty good chance that at least some of those gatherings you partook in the party game “Fibbage” from the folks behind Jackbox Games.
body: Inside the box, which is roughly the size of a standard hardcover book, the rules are on a single side of paper (the other side is an ad for Jackbox Party Pack 4 ), cardboard voting/point tokens (but strangely no bag to put them in), six dry-erase markers with boards, and 300 cards with prompts. The prompts themselves span an eclectic range of topics, from asking about chefs who cook ducks with hair dryers to Japan-exclusive flavors of Pepsi. The impressive number of cards means you will have a good number of games to get through before you start getting many repeats, which is great.

The Fibbage Card Game, just like the digital version, is ripe for expansion after expansion, and knowing Jackbox, I imagine it won’t be long until we start seeing packs of additional prompt cards, different themed prompts, and extra markers and boards to write on. There really isn’t any reason that you can’t expand the player count to as high as you want, so long as you have things to write with and on, and something to keep track of the points with.

articles.title: All sprites in Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4
articles.summary: Sprites are back again in Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4, though they're sporting a pixel-y gamer look to coincide with the "Override" season. Just like last season, these sprites can be found around the map, and you can equip them to gain bonus effects to help you get that sweet Victory Royale.
body: Again, you'll need to find these sprites, level them up, and extract them using either the huge extractors around the map or portable extractors (in your gizmo inventory) if you want to use them in your next match. Once you extract a sprite, you can re-summon it using sprite dust if you lose it in a match. You can earn sprite dust by extracting sprites. We strongly recommend you use the admin panel lobby codes to get a jumpstart on collecting sprite dust and some rare sprites variations.

Update (Aug. 29): We've added the Storm Scout sprite to this list.

articles.title: Exclusive: D&D's Japanese Rival Creators Talk About Imminent English Launch
articles.summary: You might be surprised to know that, in Japan, Dungeons & Dragons ' claim of being "the world's most famous RPG" has never even come close to being true. The game's history in the country is fascinating, and its lack of popularity is due to several factors, not least some less-than-optimal sales…
body: Created by Group SNE in 1989, Sword World RPG has been a mainstay in Japan for decades, but it has never received an official English translation, until now. Mugen Gaming, a company that specializes in translating and distributing Japanese games, has been hard at work on the first official English translation of Sword World RPG 2.5, the latest edition of the game. After a long wait, it was finally announced this week that a Backerkit campaign will launch on Oct. 20.

Fans will be very excited to learn that the project's art director is Shunsuke Nakashige, a prolific anime director whose credits include Solo Leveling: ReAwakening. Hitoshi Yoneda, one of the lead artists for the Record of Lodoss War series, will draw cover art for the collector's edition of the book.
Polygon had the opportunity to interview Hitoshi Yasuda, Group SNE's president, about the legacy of Sword World RPG and the imminent, historic first launch of the game in English.

articles.title: We Played State of Decay 3 and It's in Good Shape Despite the Xbox Upheaval | gamescom 2026
articles.summary: State of Decay 3 seems to be showing promise after playing an action-packed 30 minutes of an early alpha build.
body: It's been a tumultuous time for development teams around the Xbox umbrella, including Undead Labs which is in the process of changing ownership amid the "Xbox reset." This left us with tons of questions about the state of its upcoming zombie-survival game State of Decay 3 and if it'd even see the light of day. Well, I played it at gamescom 2026 and I'm happy to report that the short 30-minute demo I saw and went hands-on with shows a lot of promise. Even as an early alpha build, I got a good impression of the improved gunplay and movement, and the general feeling that this is a State of the Decay worthy of the current generation while building on the series' fundamentals.

This is still very much about community management and base-building, both of which have been expanded in a few notable ways. From what I saw, facilities and buildings don't necessarily have linear upgrade paths and can instead specialize in specific functions through branching upgrades. What's just as important is which characters you assign to which facilities – for example, those who have perks or traits suited for the medical field can boost the rate at which other survivors will recover.
points: State of Decay 3 seems to be showing promise after playing an action-packed 30 minutes of an early alpha build.

articles.title: Call of Duty Touts Anti-Cheat Commitment Ahead Of Modern Warfare 4
articles.summary: Call of Duty has been handing cease-and-desist letters to cheat developers ahead of the launch of Modern Warfare 4, and publicly sharing footage and images of those moments to promote its commitment to combating cheaters.
body: On Aug. 28, the official Call of Duty account on X shared a clip showing its lawyers delivering cease-and-desist demands to cheat providers and made it clear how seriously they're taking cheat software.

According to Call of Duty 's X thread, it has successfully stopped 375 cheat reseller operations and 30 vendors, and served over 80 cease-and-desist letters. With this letter, the cheaters are informed that if they continue to produce or distribute their products, legal action will be taken against them.

The company warns that it will do what it takes to protect fair play in Call of Duty games. One X posts about this had a blunt message for cheat developers:"We're prepared to take cheat developers and sellers to court to protect fair play. Build cheats. Sell cheats. We will find you."

The company's end goal is to make cheats harder to make, sell, and use. It intends to do this with Ricochet anti-cheat software, which was used during the Modern Warfare 4 early access beta. Activision claims it had very positive results, improving time to action, lowering infection rates, and facilitating hardware bans.

articles.title: GTA 6's gameplay reveal pulled in 3.97 million peak viewers, overwhelming Twitch and Netflix in the process
articles.summary: Reaction streams to Grand Theft Auto 6 's first gameplay presentation peaked at 3,970,738 viewers across livestreaming platforms, making it the biggest gaming stream of 2026 so far.
body: That's according to new data from Streams Charts, which claims 9,038 streamers covered Rockstar Games ' Netflix reveal, racking up 5,227,798 hours watched.

That puts GTA 6's reveal ahead of Summer Game Fest 2026's 3.81 million peak viewers, as well as June's Nintendo Direct and State of Play broadcasts. Twitch carried the largest share of the audience, accounting for around 44 percent of total hours watched, ahead of YouTube (34.8% percent) and Kick (20.2 percent).
Spanish streamer Juan Alberto "IlloJuan" García led the way with 233,520 peak viewers, a new record for his own channel, ahead of Rubius (191,056) and IShowSpeed (177,887).

The reveal went out at 8pm UK time, but heavy demand caused technical issues on both Netflix and Twitch, with some viewers reportedly locked out for 40-50 minutes. That didn't deter internet hype, though; Streams Charts also tracked more than 100,000 chat messages about the game across the three-hour window it analysed.

articles.title: Valve assures Deadlock players hungry for its next big update that it will notify them, 'or order a ton of pizza', when it's ready
articles.summary: I don't envy Deadlock players who are dying to see the hybrid MOBA-shooter continue to grow in its pseudo-early access state. Valve is notoriously elusive when it comes to communication and has never made any promises to update it on a regular schedule.
body: This is the kind of uncertainty that drives Deadlock players to salivate over any new rumor or post by the developer-run Discord and forum account known as Yoshi. It's also what drives them to keep watch over the pizzerias near Valve's Seattle offices for spikes in visitors in the hopes that developers are lining up for grub as they finish the next major update.

This week, Deadlock players were hoping Valve would release its follow-up to the Old Gods, New Blood update —which added six new heroes to the game along with other major changes. Valve previously said a "large content update" was in the works alongside two other smaller updates to its ranked mode and items. But now that the ranked rework is out of the way, players were hoping to see the another update before the end of the month.

According to a new post from Yoshi, the update is taking longer than expected. Yoshi doesn't specify if they're talking about the item update or the large content update—it almost implies they've been combined into one patch—but said it's going to have to wait until "late September."
points: I don't envy Deadlock players who are dying to see the hybrid MOBA-shooter continue to grow in its pseudo-early access state.

articles.title: The Long Dark will get new DLC again as studio shifts devs away from the sequel to survive an 'uncertain' industry: 'We have to adapt to this'
articles.summary: Survival game The Long Dark was supposed to be over when its final story episode was released earlier this year. Developer Hinterland announced its sequel, Blackfrost, two years ago and planned to go the early access route with it just like the first game.
body: According to a new update from the studio, however, those plans have changed a little bit. While it continues to work on Blackfrost in the background, a small team of developers have been moved back onto The Long Dark to make new DLC for its survival mode. Hinterland hopes going back to the 9-year-old game will help it endure an "uncertain" industry.

"When we first announced Blackfrost, the sequel to The Long Dark, the game industry was in a very different place," it said. "In the short time since, entire business models have been thrown into chaos, the geopolitical situation has become extremely complicated, the picture of what the next generation of console hardware will be has become a lot less clear, and the amount of time and money players spend on new games has declined as everyone turns to the comfort and security of games they already know."

articles.title: Squadron 42 delayed to 2027, with Star Citizen dev blaming GTA 6
articles.summary: Cloud Imperium Games has delayed Squadron 42, its long-in-development Star Citizen spin-off, to Q2 2027, with studio boss Chris Roberts arguing the game would be drowned out by GTA 6.
body: The single-player game had been targeting a 2026 release, as Cloud Imperium reaffirmed as recently as late last year. In a new blog post, however, Roberts said launching this autumn would mean going up against Rockstar's blockbuster, something he wasn't willing to risk for a game "that has had twelve years of blood, sweat and tears invested into it".
"At CitizenCon 2024 we announced we would ship in 2026," Roberts wrote (thanks, IGN ).

"Our plan was to release in Q4 around IAE. But much like the rest of the industry, there is no way I want to launch my spiritual successor to Wing Commander, a game that has had twelve years of blood, sweat and tears invested into it (we started Squadron 42 development in 2014 as 2013 was opening studios, hiring people and getting the Hangar module out for Star Citizen) launching into the attention buzz saw of GTA6.
"While GTA6 isn't launching on PC this November, pretty much all outlets and most content creators will be all over it, not leaving a lot of room for other coverage."

articles.title: Modern gamers spoiled by Steam will never understand the joy of a MegaPak
articles.summary: Rick has been fascinated by PC gaming since he was seven years old, when he used to sneak into his dad's home office for covert sessions of Doom. He grew up on a diet of similarly unsuitable games, with favourites including Quake, Thief, Half-Life and Deus Ex.
body: Weird Weekend is our regular Saturday column where we celebrate PC gaming oddities: peculiar games, strange bits of trivia, forgotten history. Pop back every weekend to find out what Jeremy, Josh, Ted, and Rick have become obsessed with this time, whether it's the canon height of Thief's Garrett or that time someone in the Vatican pirated Football Manager.

It's easy to be cynical about the modern games industry, what with developers being laid off left and right and hardware prices skyrocketing thanks to AI datacentres gobbling up all the components. But it's also worth pointing out the positives too. For starters, games are more abundant than ever before. More games get released in a single day than most people could feasibly play in an entire year, and those games cover every genre and experience imaginable. If you can think of a game you want to play, it probably exists in some form. If it doesn't, someone is probably trying to make it.

articles.summary: The Pokémon Company International and Aardman have released the first teaser trailer for Pokémon Tales: The Misadventures of Sirfetch'd & Pichu, a new stop-motion series set in the Galar region.
body: The video description teases: "Join our unlikely heroes, Sirfetch'd and Pichu, in their gallant quest to protect Pokémon across Galar! While their missions might rarely go as planned, their noble deeds forge their friendship as they step bravely into the unknown. Peril, alliances, rivalries, extraordinary Pokémon, and endless laughs await them."

Pokémon's director of original animation Phil Rynda joined Aardman's Tom Parkinson (director), Nat McKay (creative director, IP development), and James Young (model-making creative lead) on the panel to walk fans through the show's puppets, sets, and production process.
Disney+ was also confirmed as the series' exclusive worldwide streaming home when it arrives in 2027, following the platform's recent addition of Pokémon the Series: The Beginning.

Set across the wilds of Galar, Pokémon Tales follows Sirfetch'd and Pichu on what Pokémon describes as "a gallant quest to help and protect Pokémon across the region", with new Pokémon and location reveals including Obstagoon and the Crown Tundra area, both previously seen in Pokémon Sword and Shield.

She has given Pablo the ability to transform into the mighty La Sombra allowing him to fight back against evil.
Mariachi Legends will be available on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox, and PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, and GOG) on April 27, 2027.
videos.author: IGN

videos.title: The Witcher 3: Songs Of The Past Is A Mystery Centered On Dandelion
videos.summary: GameSpot was also able to attend a hands-off presentation, where we learned all about The Witcher 3 - Wild Hunt Songs of the Past’s Dandelion-centered storyline.
body: CD Projekt Red returns to its fantasy-themed action-RPG after over a decade, and the developer says this expansion takes Geralt on one last ride “before passing the torch.”
